list.title: Vessels
list.description: Fleet master data: identity, dimensions, engines, fuel, photo, last position and CII rating.
list.searchLabel: Search vessels by name, MMSI or IMO
list.noMatchDescription: Change the search or the type and status filters to see other vessels.
list.emptyFleet: Your fleet has no vessels yet
list.emptyDescription: Add your first vessel: enter its identity, dimensions and engines, or take its data from the registry.
list.emptyNoWrite: Ask an organization admin or fleet manager to add vessels.
list.allScopeNote: Vessels of other organizations show their identity only; technical data, CII and telemetry are private to the owner.
list.technicalHidden: Technical data is visible to the owning organization only

detail.title: Vessel Details
detail.invalidMmsiHint: An MMSI has 9 digits. Check the link or find the vessel in the list.
detail.restrictedDescription: Dimensions, engines, fuel, CII and telemetry of this vessel are visible to its owning organization only (tenancy rule §8.5).

fields.name: Vessel name
fields.annualVoyagePercentage: Share of the year at sea

overview.dimensionsDescription: Inputs of the CII capacity and of the Holtrop–Mennen resistance chain of the emission service.
overview.noEnginesHint: Add the main and auxiliary engines with the Edit button.
overview.noFormula: No formula: the emission service uses telemetry when active, then the Holtrop model.

formula.previewAt: At the service speed of {{speed}} kn: {{value}} L/min
formula.createFailed: The formula could not be created
formula.newDescription: Fuel flow (L/min) as a function of speedKnot. Formulas are checked with the same safe grammar as the fleet and emission services.
formula.name: Formula name
formula.grammarHint: Numbers, speedKnot, + - * / ** ^ ( ) and exp, log, ln, sqrt, pow, abs, min, max (optionally Math.). ^ means power.
formula.noneHint: Without a first formula, fuel comes from telemetry (when active) or the Holtrop model.

issues.tooLong: The formula is longer than {{max}} characters
issues.unexpectedCharacter: Character "{{text}}" is not allowed at position {{position}}
issues.unknownIdentifier: Unknown name "{{text}}" at position {{position}} (only speedKnot and the functions are allowed)
issues.tooDeep: The formula is nested deeper than {{max}} levels (position {{position}})
issues.tooManyTokens: The formula has more than {{max}} tokens (position {{position}})

live.heading: Heading
live.noPositionHint: The vessel has not reported a position in the last 24 hours. It appears here as soon as one arrives.
live.safetyDescription: Pipeline EWS status and collision risk from the safety service.
live.noSafetyHint: The state is computed when the next position arrives.

cii.title: CII {{year}}
cii.scaleLabel: Attained CII {{value}} on the rating scale A to E
cii.dailyCaption: Cumulative attained CII per day compared with the required CII
cii.empty: No CII data this year yet
cii.emptyHint: The CII is computed from AIS voyage segments. Data appears once the vessel sails and its fuel is computed.
cii.figuresDescription: g CO₂ per capacity·nm, current calendar year.

telemetry.dailyDescription: Daily (UTC) sums of the fuel meter readings. Telemetry is active with a reading in the last {{minutes}} minutes.
telemetry.emptyHint: Install an MQTT/HTTP device or enter readings manually on the Telemetry page.
telemetry.methodNote: While telemetry is active the emission service uses these readings for segment fuel.
telemetry.latestDescription: The newest raw readings received by the telemetry service (metric tonnes).

alerts.title: Vessel alerts
alerts.description: The latest 20 alerts involving this vessel (as main or related vessel).
alerts.emptyHint: EWS, collision and surveillance alerts of this vessel appear here.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The vessel with MMSI {{mmsi}} and its dimensions, engines, ports and photo are removed from the fleet. AIS and CII history are kept. This cannot be undone.
delete.failed: The vessel could not be deleted

form.createDescription: Register a vessel in the active organization's fleet. Prefill it from the registry to save time.
form.editDescription: Changes to identity, dimensions, engines and ports are published to the emission, safety and surveillance services.
form.notOwnTitle: This vessel belongs to another organization
form.notOwnDescription: Only the owning organization (or a platform admin) can change vessel data.

sections.identityHint: Identity data is shared with every platform user.
sections.typeHint: The type sets the CII reference line; the fuel sets the CO₂ factor.
sections.dimensionsHint: Lengths in metres, speed in knots, coefficients without unit.
sections.enginesHint: One main engine row (with a quantity) and auxiliary engines, at most 16 rows.
sections.portsHint: Order of the ports on the vessel's route.

form.bulbousBowHint: Used by the Holtrop resistance model (bulb area A_BT).
form.tenancyNote: The vessel is created in your active organization. Technical data, CII and telemetry are visible to this organization only.

errors.flag: Use a 2-letter country code, e.g. ID
errors.duplicateEngine: This engine is already chosen in another row

photo.title: Vessel photo
photo.tooLarge: The photo is larger than 5 MB
photo.limits: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB
photo.uploadFailedAfterCreate: The vessel was saved but the photo upload failed
photo.afterCreate: The photo is uploaded once the vessel is saved.
photo.removeDescription: The photo is deleted from storage and cannot be restored.
photo.removeFailed: The photo could not be removed

ports.order: Order of the ports of call

registry.title: Search the ship registry
registry.description: Public ship particulars (secondary registry). Pick an entry to fill the identity and principal dimensions.
registry.label: Registry search
registry.startHint: Names match from the start; digits match IMO numbers or MMSIs.
registry.noneHint: Try another spelling or enter the vessel data manually.

VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Some data is not valid
VALIDATION_FAILED.detail: Check the highlighted fields and save again.

FORBIDDEN.title: Access denied
FORBIDDEN.detail: This vessel belongs to another organization or your role does not allow this action.

ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED.title: Choose an active organization
ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED.detail: Vessels are created in the active organization; choose one with the organization switcher.

PLATFORM_ADMIN_REQUIRED.title: Platform admins only
PLATFORM_ADMIN_REQUIRED.detail: Only platform admins can change this field.

VESSEL_NOT_FOUND.title: Vessel not found
VESSEL_NOT_FOUND.detail: The vessel may have been deleted or its MMSI changed.

REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.title: Registry entry not found
REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.detail: No particulars with that IMO number or MMSI.

PHOTO_NOT_FOUND.title: Photo not found
PHOTO_NOT_FOUND.detail: This vessel has no photo yet.

MMSI_ALREADY_EXISTS.title: MMSI already registered
MMSI_ALREADY_EXISTS.detail: Each MMSI belongs to one vessel on the platform.

IMO_ALREADY_EXISTS.title: IMO number already registered
IMO_ALREADY_EXISTS.detail: Another vessel already uses this IMO number.

REFERENCE_IN_USE.title: Reference data still in use
REFERENCE_IN_USE.detail: Move the vessels to other reference data first.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: Photo too large
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.detail: Photos can be up to 5 MB.

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Photo storage unavailable
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: Try the upload again in a moment.
